reasoning: Prior to this commit, `compilerComplianceLevel` was stored as a converted `JavaVersion` field (`this.compilerComplianceLevel = JavaVersion.toVersion(compilerComplianceLevel)`), so `.toString()` on it produced the normalized version string. This refactor moved the logic to a local lambda but mistakenly used the raw String parameter `compilerComplianceLevel` directly (calling `.toString()` on the String itself) instead of converting it via `JavaVersion.toVersion(...)`, losing the normalization and introducing the bug.
